failed_allocs.note: heap allocations that failed since boot (diag.c callback); several callers drop a failure silently

internal_free_kb.note: one reading; 25-55 KB until v1.12.0, ~96 KB since (radar palettes, cJSON in PSRAM)

internal_min_kb.note: lowest internal RAM since boot, read in perf. 8-10 KB until v1.12.0 (3 KB once); 48-50 KB since the radar palettes and cJSON moved to PSRAM

internal_min_kb.reconnect.note: lowest since boot after wifi_setup's reconnect path (three TLS clients + the forecast parse): 4-5 KB until v1.12.0, 76 KB since

lvgl_internal_fallbacks.note: LVGL blocks put in internal RAM because PSRAM was full (lvgl_mem.c)

page_kb.note: settings page size (sent in 1 KB TLS records); a big jump is worth a look

psram_min_kb.note: v1.11.0: 452-517 KB with the 5-picture cache of slide.c (1042 in v1.10.0); the radar needs ~50 KB to decode plus 217 KB per new frame

radar_zoom_start_ms.note: overlays rendered with alpha before the first frame (mostly the range ring)

render_ms.blank.note: a few ms: noise is a large part of it

render_ms.hourly.note: v1.11.1 with QIO flash (DIO: weather 67, hourly 51, radar 56, with panel 94); a board updated over the air keeps a DIO bootloader and renders at the DIO speed
